identity.name: Inaria
identity.presentation: 20-year-old adult woman with a youthful, soft, natural presentation

facial_identity.face_identity: Recognizable and consistent Inaria facial identity
facial_identity.face_shape: Preserve the established face shape and major facial structure from the age-20 reference
facial_identity.facial_proportions: Preserve recognizable relative placement and proportions of major facial features
facial_identity.skin: Light, natural-looking skin with realistic texture
facial_identity.expression: May vary naturally among neutral, gentle happiness, mild surprise, or varied smile intensity without changing facial identity

hair.style_policy: Hair arrangement, parting, loose hair, waves, ponytail, and bun styles may vary across the dataset
hair.identity_requirement: All hairstyles must remain recognizably Inaria and must not create a different character

eyes.structure: Preserve recognizable overall eye structure and placement
eyes.variation_policy: Expression and gaze may vary, but arbitrary eye-color changes are not permitted

body.presentation: Slender, feminine overall body proportions appropriate to the active age-20 reference
body.anatomy: Believably human anatomy with plausible joints, limb angles, balance, and center of gravity
body.measurement_policy: No unapproved numeric facial or body measurements are introduced

prompt_module.character_prompt: inr20, Inaria, 20-year-old adult woman, consistent facial identity, established dark blue-black long hair, blue eyes, light natural-looking skin, slender feminine proportions, [expression]
prompt_module.module_boundary: Character descriptors remain separate from clothing, scene, pose/camera, lighting/style, and task-specific generation details

dataset_guidance.identity_target: Teach Inaria as a person rather than as one fixed outfit, hairstyle, pose, scene, camera angle, or lighting setup

locked_constraints: Use the designated age-20 standard portrait as the primary visual identity reference for this task
Represent Inaria as a 20-year-old adult; do not use the age-36 portrait as the primary identity target while the age-20 task is active
Preserve overall facial identity
Preserve face shape and major facial structure
Preserve core facial proportions and recognizable feature placement
Preserve established dark blue-black hair color
Preserve established blue eye color
Preserve the intended slender feminine body proportions
Maintain a clearly adult but youthful age-20 presentation
Maintain believable human anatomy
Each visible hand must have exactly five plausible fingers
Each visible bare foot must have exactly five plausible toes
Exclude extra, missing, fused, duplicated, or severely malformed digits
Exclude extra limbs, duplicated body parts, impossible joints, and severe deformation
Keep body balance and center of gravity believable
Do not invent unspecified numeric facial, iris, hair-length, or body measurements
Do not encode clothing, scene, pose, camera, background, or lighting as permanent identity traits
Do not allow one outfit, hairstyle, scene, pose, camera angle, lighting condition, or color scheme to dominate the dataset as an accidental identity signal

Character-related negative constraints include different person or identity drift, wrong face shape, distorted facial features, severe facial asymmetry or deformation, wrong age appearance, wrong hair color, deformed hands, extra or missing fingers, fused or duplicated fingers, elongated fingers, deformed feet, extra or missing toes, fused or duplicated toes, extra limbs, malformed anatomy, unnatural limb angles, impossible joints, severe body-proportion distortion, plastic-looking skin, excessive facial smoothing, and exaggerated makeup
Any identity-changing or systemic character failure is rejectable rather than repairable
Character constraints must be handed off without silently overriding Clothing, Scene, Pose/Camera, Prompt/Generation, or Director/QA authority

permitted: Hairstyle and hair arrangement while retaining dark blue-black color
Hair parting, loose hair, waves, ponytail, or bun styles
Natural facial expressions including neutral, serious, gentle happiness, mild surprise, and varied smile intensity
Clothing and accessories supplied by the Clothing Department
Scene and background supplied by the Scene Department
Pose, camera angle, and framing supplied by the Pose/Camera Department
Lighting and visual style supplied by the applicable style and scene specifications
Age-appropriate styling differences supported by the designated age-20 reference
intentional_variations.variation_control: Change external conditions intentionally and in a controlled manner while preserving identity-critical facial structure, dark blue-black hair color, blue eyes, intended body proportions, and adult age-20 presentation
prohibited_variation: Use of a single hairstyle as an identity lock
Use of a single outfit, scene, pose, camera angle, lighting setup, or background as an identity lock
Youth stereotypes or inferred age styling that conflict with the designated age-20 reference

notes: Source authority: MASTER_SPEC.md sha a9977b7763e9110ad877dbac074452b336a7369e and CHARACTER_SPEC.md sha 943ceca501dc0e513a0b488443a6f6221407a45d.
Character identity is evaluated as a whole-person identity rather than by one isolated feature.
Age-20 identity takes priority over decorative detail and over inferred styling assumptions.
Repair is appropriate only for localized, technically reliable defects that preserve the original identity and surrounding image; otherwise replace the candidate.

Character handoff to downstream departments must include the active age variant, designated reference, locked traits, allowed variations, consistency criteria, repair-versus-reject criteria, prompt structure, negative baseline, and unresolved cross-department conflicts.
Default setting information such as modern Taiwan in 2026 is not a permanent character lock and remains under scene authority.
